# Citation File Format test schema

`cff-1.2.0.schema.json` is the unmodified Citation File Format 1.2.0 schema,
by the Citation File Format developers, from
<https://github.com/citation-file-format/citation-file-format/blob/1.2.0/schema.json>.

Upstream licence: **CC-BY-4.0**; a copy is in `LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`.
SHA-256: `0b8d22140da702d766df318dcff3a91af2f39521298dcf36d76315fd99cc169b`.

Vendored solely so citation validation is reproducible and does not require a
network request or secret. This is upstream test data, not application code.
